parameters.query:
select
  insert_escalation($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) as escalation_id,
  escalation_recipients($1, $2) as notify_email,
  (select name from tenants where id = $1) as tenant_name,
  -- 0033: the client's details and the conversation so far, for the email.
  escalation_context($1, $2) as context;

nodes.name: Insert Escalation
nodes.notes: notify_email = escalation_recipients(): the agent who owns this visitor's lead (or the whole team if nobody owns it yet), for everyone who has alerts switched on in Team, plus the agency-wide address from Settings. Comma-separated.
